patch.value: Compact compound lifecycle receipts without losing SDK results

Temporary acceptance with an 18000-byte description measured plain claim JSON at 160 bytes and claim --start at 37193 bytes, including two full item snapshots. Add explicit compact CLI/MCP presentation for compound lifecycle operations while retaining full public SDK results, full-output access and documented compatibility behavior.

Cover claim --start, release --pause and close --release-assignment through shared presentation contracts; preserve complete typed SDK results and explicit full output; compact receipts report truthful ownership, lifecycle state and partial success; verify installed large-metadata CLI/MCP sessions and legacy alias compatibility
Reduce repeated context cost for agent lifecycle loops
Compound lifecycle receipts scale with changed fields rather than complete item metadata
Real acceptance during PR 1237 review closeout exposed a 232-fold response expansion for claim --start
